### 2026-10-18 – # Week 2 Progress Report

**3h**

# Week 2 Progress Report

This week, I started working on the drivebase for the robot I'm designing in Onshape. On Monday, I spent around 3 hours planning how I wanted the drivebase to look and figuring out how I wanted to lay out the frame.

![Initial drivebase frame](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/11c2dfc24d3791d377db458efc3a78a022e675cef024166a682b14326d728cbe.png)

This is my vision for how the rest of the bot could look like and the specific dimensions im going to be designing my drivebase around:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/95c31bdc6cafbc9043ef9923fca02b1dde66dbc565279d5906b7f9e766b160d2.png)

After that, I started filling in the frame with the swerve modules and other structural components to get a better idea of how everything would fit together.

![Drivebase prototype with swerve modules](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/8a27b406af31cb4778eb302b76fb5a57db175fbebd0e01727f0c979d17261d1f.png)

This is still an early prototype, so I'm not sure if I'll keep this exact design or make changes as I go. For now, I'm mainly focused on getting the overall layout right and making sure the swerve modules and frame fit together properly before moving on to more detailed parts of the robot.

### 2026-10-18 – ## Tuesday

**3h**

## Tuesday

On Tuesday, I spent another 3 hours working on the robot concept and refining the drivebase. I started by working on the overall robot design without the drivebase to get a better idea of how I wanted everything to fit together.

![Robot concept without drivebase](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/cb4ba978a01e92228860d71172be6f982e699a36c408f919233acac5faae1cf9.png)

I decided to use wood for the frame and designed the final perimeter for the drivebase. It's a pretty simple design for now, but it gives me a starting point for building the rest of the structure around it.

![Drivebase perimeter](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/bbdc61db2607bcd273ee4a359c5487c192bbdf6c66144ae4cd10c9e4f7defcef.png)

For the swerve modules, I decided to go with the MK4i modules from SDS. They fit nicely within the perimeter and leave enough room for the structural frame, battery, and electronics. I used the CAD model directly from SDS to make sure I was designing around the actual module dimensions rather than estimating everything myself.

![SDS MK4i swerve module CAD](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/2d3b01786b0092cdae3eca60fd33a8ee03db25e3a3e794598c409c0c9b17e4f2.png)

wish me luck i gotta now start actually cadding...

### 2026-10-18 – ## Wednesday

**3h**

## Wednesday

On Wednesday, I spent another 3 hours working on the swerve drivebase and refining the overall robot design. I ended up going back to my original concept because the dual-turret design wasn't really working out the way I wanted it to.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/ea45583743b35a80534b8a9619b0c22ef98255770979ef75c8817c821aa11418.png)

I also switched the swerve module caps back to the original ones instead of using my own custom designs. I added the base frame and some box tubing to better define the structure and get a clearer idea of how everything will fit together. I temporarily removed all the electronics because they were overlapping with other parts of the model and making it harder to work on the structure.

![Updated swerve drivebase and structural frame](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/c29708585e2fc71f8f73616e76c9d4bd5031f3bad792c8040984f2e320921801.png)

Here's the full model so far. I also spent some time fixing a few weird dimension issues to make sure the parts lined up properly.

![Full robot CAD model](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/e5e6ca689477526db016f946099d00e22599191436fc0f4eee066aa4e5d1db2e.png)

### 2026-10-18 – ## Thursday

**3h**

## Thursday

On Thursday, I spent more time getting the drivebase closer to completion. I added a cover for the electronics and made some changes to the component layout to make everything fit together better. I also added a few more components, although I realized afterward that I had forgotten to include a gyroscope.

![Updated electronics layout and cover](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/e7829ca4d82a8db3554db5b5c8c5b6ac3ec4eca6dd4c816ec5cba503e6daf40b.png)

After that, I brought back my custom covers for the swerve modules and finished up the main frame. At this point, the overall structure is coming together, and the drivebase is starting to look much closer to what I originally had in mind.

![Completed drivebase frame with custom covers](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/e76a27920c3901fa09ff49b3fd8a885ea3f73ebc3488fb2241f7f19af41d74ff.png)

I also took inspiration from other swerve drivebases while working on the design. This was the main reference I used to help guide the layout and structure.

![Reference swerve drivebase](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/da7cc9d645360ed5519a86dc8ae1dbe6614bb7de08c159278fa69435219ed0bb.png)

### 2026-10-18 – ## Friday

**3h**

## Friday

On Friday, I spent more time finishing up the drivebase. The frame is practically done now, and the overall model is pretty much complete. At this point, I'd mainly need to go back through everything, refine the design, and add any smaller parts I might have missed.

![Nearly completed robot frame](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/f143d5cca283a758e992f986ddc6078ec7ea7bdf4dbb54fe8583b2cdd3614fd1.png)

I also finished the base itself, which gives the rest of the robot a solid structure to build around.

![Completed drivebase](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/4b38b21789b437e42f17e2a8d4bd2d49821aa0cecf4875aeba3691e794d9384f.png)

One other change I made was upgrading the swerve modules from the MK4i to the MK5N, which is the newer design.

![Updated MK5N swerve modules](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/77bd19ca6413a849c65c7ee01bb6151a7aa1bd6b88b757057b2757bbaa440398.png)

### 2026-10-18 – ## Friday

**3h**

## Friday
I added bumpers to the drivebase to make the model more complete and get a better idea of how the robot will look with its outer protection.

![Drivebase with bumpers](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/5b9d0582c715adb6ad35b2d41beec104bb38ff3ee6b666c1005e172972fe4c2d.png)

I also spent more time working on the indexer. I still need to change some of the measurements to make sure it lines up properly with the drivebase, but the design is starting to come together.

![Indexer CAD progress](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/3095c7bc96a08ad34c8d5d11e70afc7b87a074697fd13cf033ef46021b258197.png)

One of the main changes I made was adjusting the roller size. This is important for getting the indexer geometry right and making sure the different parts fit together properly. I'll continue refining the dimensions and checking the alignment before integrating the indexer into the full robot model.

![Updated indexer roller](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/b68fbb29db97c2213cc4c385a8730f41673e73224d5dbf947c29370eaecaf470.png)

### 2026-10-18 – ## More Indexer and Intake Progress

**3h**

## More Indexer and Intake Progress

I found that directly adjusting the end cap dimensions was much faster than trying to get everything to line up by changing the roller size. This made it easier to fix the fit without having to keep tweaking other parts of the design.

![Updated end cap dimensions](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/bdd50813fb82d2a699929d3deb411188b1bbfcebbed8ae360da06524eb4fe36a.png)

I also started working on the intake, first putting together a prototype to figure out its overall size and dimensions.

![Intake prototype dimensions](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/bf83d0c648407855a60635716e6fadf90cc9358be0586adf90e9c1d2f92b51f9.png)

After getting the basic dimensions sorted out, I worked on the actual intake design. This gives me a starting point for integrating it with the rest of the robot and checking how everything will fit together.

![Intake design](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qS2bceLRVTmEuNM9IZhPK3Fw79ZUnkMt/5a13928362df5ace7874a0c9b3f73da0d4a7c4e0195e419158066062e6ba1545.png)
